object_description: polygonal building volume wrapped by arcades
design_condition: The nearly plot-filling volume follows the surrounding alignments and eaves height, while its arcades, shared space, path network, and green structures mediate its scale within the sloping campus.

positive.statement: The uniform roof edge and varying-depth arcades take away the force of the volume and weave it into the surroundings.

position.rationale: Continuous upper boundary is clearly visible around the principal polygonal volume.

positive.statement: The clear fronts are geometrically integrated into the important alignments, creating a well-proportioned shared space that also provides access.

position.rationale: Front-facing lower zone is anchored along the visible southern and eastern approaches.

positive.statement: The new building is cleverly integrated into the difficult topography, and the network of paths and green structures can strengthen the campus idea.

position.target: network of paths and green structures
position.rationale: Approximate landscape and circulation region lies around the detached western mass and main volume.

positive.statement: The interior is zoned and structured in an amazingly simple, logical, and exciting way.

position.rationale: Interior organization is approximated within the principal sampled building footprint.

positive.statement: The attractive two-story workshop hall with central daylight promotes exchange between disciplines and gives the institution an important symbol.

position.rationale: Workshop hall is placed centrally within the tall principal volume, with daylight inferred from its exposed position.

positive.statement: The wood-concrete hybrid system makes sense, with pragmatic materialization decisions enabling an attractive working atmosphere.

position.rationale: Material system is anchored to the principal building envelope where its working atmosphere is expressed.

positive.statement: The arcade zone determines the appearance of the new school and promises a great variety.

position.rationale: Variable-depth perimeter bands visibly wrap the main polygonal volume.

positive.statement: The sustainability concept is well thought out and can become part of the overall concept.

position.rationale: Sustainability is a non-local conceptual judgment without a distinct geometric marker.

positive.statement: The project combines innovative and intelligent positions into an independent, future-oriented learning workshop.

position.rationale: Broad identity judgment is anchored to the principal polygonal building volume.

negative.statement: The courtyard at the existing technical center is not convincing and shows no creative engagement with the historical context.

position.target: courtyard at the existing technical center
position.rationale: Courtyard is approximated in the western detached cluster visible beside the main volume.

negative.statement: The desired play areas in the eastern area are possible but are not shown.

position.target: play areas in the eastern area
position.rationale: Eastern open area is placed along the main volume’s rightmost visible edge.

negative.statement: The sloping space between the streets appears helpless and indeterminate.

position.rationale: Intermediate open space is located between the detached western outline and principal polygon.

negative.statement: Five almost equivalent entrances significantly obscure the addressing.

position.rationale: Multiple entrances are assigned to the principal lower front zone and adjoining exposed edges.

negative.statement: The external workspace areas are tempting, but functionality is not yet guaranteed at the proposed height.

position.rationale: External work areas are approximated on elevated exposed edges of the main volume.

negative.statement: The zone between the two main areas of use remains unclearly assigned and spatially unclear.

position.target: zone between the two main areas of use
position.rationale: Ambiguous intermediate zone is placed within the central transition of the principal footprint.

negative.statement: A clearer decision in favor of one architectural expression would enable greater precision.

position.rationale: Expression is anchored across the visibly articulated polygonal envelope and arcade perimeter.

negative.statement: It remains open how the exceeded total building height could be compensated for.

position.rationale: Height concern is assigned directly to the clearly visible upper building boundary.

negative.statement: The large proportion of windows and lack of central building-technology areas cloud the intention of developing an intelligent building.

position.rationale: Envelope openings and service organization are approximated on the exposed principal façades.
